# MoneyPuck fixtures

Data from MoneyPuck.com.

Downloaded on 2026-11-03 from the two files that the MoneyPuck data page lists.
Each file keeps its real header and only the rows of a few games.

- `all_teams_sample.csv`: `https://moneypuck.com/moneypuck/playerData/careers/gameByGame/all_teams.csv`.
  The games cover the 2013 season (dropped by the reader), old team codes, ARI, a playoff game, and one 2026 game.
- `goalies_2025_sample.zip`: `https://peter-tanner.com/moneypuck/downloads/seasonPlayersSummary/goalies/2025.zip`.
  It holds the rows of games 2025020697 and 2025020709.
